summary: Extract korea-2024 sprites as PNG reference art (task)
author: pm
body:
Download every .pak in Original-Helbreath/History `sprites/korea-2024` (405 files, about 890 MB, measured via the GitHub API 2026-11-23) and convert each sprite sheet to `classic_ui/reference/<pak>/<nnn>.png` with a `frames.json`. Downloads in `build/downloads/korea-2024/`; output gitignored. Closes when its sub-tasks are done.

**Done when:** every parsable pak is converted and spot-checked.

Source: user request 2026-11-23.

**Verified, 2026-11-23:** 405/405 paks downloaded (889,957,672 B, sizes match the API) and converted to 13,659 PNGs (461 MB) plus frames.json; spot checks of New-Dialog, Guard and EFFECT sheets passed; download folder deleted. Unverified: the 56 sprites whose key colour is absent fall back to the top-left pixel, not compared with the original client.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Moved 2026-11-23 at the user's correction: the art belongs in the local working folder, now C:\Users\ShadowEvil\source\Helbreath-Heldenian-Project\working\classic_ui\reference\<pak>\ (405 folders). The root classic_ui folder is removed and its .gitignore line dropped (working/ is already ignored). pak_to_png.py takes the output root as an argument, so no script change.
